title: Door 14 — C Wing — Unusual Activity Detected

fields.organization: Halverson Unified School District — Facilities Operations
fields.location: C Wing, Door 14 (exterior exit, near Room 320)
fields.summary: Custodian Ray Chen conducted a routine door check at 09:20 and found Door 14 locked from the outside but not sealed. The emergency exit light is off. A muffled voice was heard from behind the door, not consistent with the PA system. No one responded to verbal calls. The handle was cold to the touch, suggesting no recent internal use. No visible signs of forced entry. The door appears to be physically locked but not secured from the inside.

findings.notes: Locked from outside, but not sealed; handle cold, no sign of internal activity
Not illuminated
No response to verbal call from inside the hallway
No visible damage or tool marks
No cracks, warping, or breakage
No debris, no footprints, no suspicious items
HUSD-VMS01 unreachable; unable to verify alarm link
Key in possession, tested on Door 14
SIS on tablet shows 05:00 roster; matches current student count
Manual override not possible — door locked from outside

actionsTaken: Notified Site Incident Commander (Prin) via radio at 09:20
Attempted verbal contact through door using bullhorn
Verified emergency light status and door lock state manually
Confirmed no visible signs of breach or external tampering
Initiated emergency light test using battery-powered flashlight
recommendations: Activate emergency light and verify power source via manual override
Dispatch Facilities Lead to perform physical door verification and secure from inside
Use bullhorn to call for help if response is still not received
Confirm door status with 05:00 roster and cross-check with on-site staff
Report to EOC for escalation per HUSD-CIRP-2026 Section 7 (C-1 to C-5)
fields.photosNote: 2 photos attached: IMG_2026-0414-0022-01 (Door 14 exterior, cold handle), IMG_2026-0414-0022-02 (emergency light off, no response to call)

instructorNote: This inject introduces physical system integrity concerns in Manual Mode. The players must verify door status through physical inspection and activate emergency protocols per EOP Section 6.1. Watch for delayed verification or over-reliance on digital systems.
